title: Michael's strange sightings in Missouri, the Ozarks and Texas
summary: Michael Johnson tells of Michael's strange sightings in Missouri, the Ozarks and Texas, about unspecified at Texas (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have seen strange occurrences in Missouri, in the Ozarks,

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard who says he had an encounter at a nuclear missile site, also says he has seen other strange things over the years. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says these happened in Missouri, in the Ozarks hill country, and in Texas, though he gives no dates or details.
